items.title: Fractured Crystal Circle Slat DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Doors
items.description: An angular, shattered-glass style medallion built from irregular triangular facets breaks up an otherwise minimal slatted panel. The contrast between the rigid horizontal slats and the chaotic crystal core gives this design a modern, edgy feel suited to contemporary gates and loft-style partitions.

items.title: Geometric Interlocking Islamic Star Fretwork Panel for CNC Routing
items.description: A high-impact, symmetrical geometric masterpiece showcasing an intricate matrix of traditional Islamic interlocking polygons and sharp star clusters. This seamless mosaic layout radiates outward across the double panels, blending historical mathematical precision with modern abstract lines.
